title: Tuxedo Junction and Tuxedo Park
summary: He describes the streetcar stop and the amusement park with a ferris wheel and pool where he played afternoons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But, for the purposes of the interview, why don't you tell us something about Tuxedo Park and Tuxedo Junction and all of that.

Well, Tuxedo Junction, like I said before, was where we used to get off the streetcar, which is Tuxedo Junction. From there, I used to walk a couple of blocks to Tuxedo Park. Now, this is something where they had all kinds of entertainment. It's, well, like the ferris wheel, swimming pool. You know, everything that you have to get around to. It's like a regular park I should say.

So, it was a lot of fun. So, we started playing out there in the afternoon and I think we quit about 7:00 at night, 8:00 cause there wasn't nothing out there at night. Then, we'd go back to Tuxedo Junction which is a couple of blocks to get on the streetcar. And, we'd ride back to the city. You know, it's a suburb right in the city, which was the subway to Birmingham.
Well, let me see, like Willie Mays, a few others, you know, all of them stayed out there. I'm trying to figure out who else I could call. I didn't know them, though, when I was at Tuxedo.
The way it is right now, you wouldn't know it. All they have there now is the big plaque at the building. But, everything is changed like other cities. But, it's beautiful, though.
